command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ns=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes' -Method Get).node_id; `$c=[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); foreach(`$n in `$ns){`$u1='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork-for-perf_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$c; `$u2='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$c; try{`$x=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u1 -Method Get).output; `$y=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u2 -Method Get).output; if(`$x -notmatch '^Error:' -and `$y -notmatch '^Error:'){`$a=`$x -split '\r?\n'; `$b=`$y -split '\r?\n'; `$d=Compare-Object `$a `$b | Where-Object {`$_.InputObject -notmatch '^!Last configuration|^snmp-agent local-engineid'}; if(`$d){'===== '+`$n+' ====='; `$d | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 240}}}catch{}}"
